lines.text: &fThe battle pass: 128 free rewards and 64 Prime ones for this season.
&7Every claimed daily task, every battle pass task and some events give points. 100 points open a free level, 200 a Prime level.

&7Levels come in 8 blocks (16 free, 8 Prime), one per stage of the quest book: stone age, bronze, steel, LV, MV, HV, EV, IV. A block's rewards can only be taken once its quest is done. Points keep coming meanwhile, so nothing is lost.
&7Every Monday and Thursday 4 new tasks appear: 3 easy and 1 hard. Prime players get one more. They stay until the season ends.
&7A box framed in gold is ready: click it. Red with a lock: reached, but its block's quest is not done yet. The button at the top puts the Prime row above or below.
